proof_scope: Proof integrity: the proof validator recomputes validity from the artifact's own structural evidence, so a producer cannot certify its own success. A hand-edited proofValid=true over a stop that never happened, or a frame borrowed from an unrelated source, is rejected; a genuinely captured proof still validates.

claims.proves: validate_debugger_proof.py rejects a tampered proofValid=true and a frame that matches no breakpoint that hit, while accepting a real bdb capture
claims.does_not_prove: source-hash re-establishment, session correlation, or hash-chained event continuity -- those need producer-emitted provenance not yet present and remain open on #1436

cases.name: reject-hand-edited-proofvalid
cases.description: A canonical proof with proofValid hand-edited to true but stopped.hit=false and no breakpoint hit must be rejected under --expect-valid by independent recomputation.
command: set -euo pipefail; export UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="${UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT:-/mnt/storage12tb/skills/debugger/.venv}"; export UV_LINK_MODE=copy; uv run --project .. python ../scripts/validate_debugger_proof.py proofs/canonical-tampered-proofvalid.json --expect-valid

cases.name: reject-borrowed-frame
cases.description: A proof whose stopped frame is in a different file than the breakpoint that hit must be rejected: the frame does not correspond to the requested breakpoint.
command: set -euo pipefail; export UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="${UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT:-/mnt/storage12tb/skills/debugger/.venv}"; export UV_LINK_MODE=copy; uv run --project .. python ../scripts/validate_debugger_proof.py proofs/canonical-tampered-frame-mismatch.json --expect-valid

cases.name: accept-genuine-capture
cases.description: A real bdb capture on the variable_state module produces a proof whose independent recomputation agrees with the producer, so it validates.
command: set -euo pipefail; export UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="${UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT:-/mnt/storage12tb/skills/debugger/.venv}"; export UV_LINK_MODE=copy; D="$(mktemp -d)"; cp ../scenarios/variable_state/*.py "$D/"; export PYTHONPATH="$D"; uv run --project .. python ../scripts/capture_breakpoints.py --break "$D/main.py:21" --local first --local second --out "$D/proof.json" -- "$D/main.py"; uv run --project .. python ../scripts/validate_debugger_proof.py "$D/proof.json" --expect-valid
